fusions.name: Drop Flat
fusions.desc: You leap up to 5 tiles and come down on the ground, dealing 13 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, knocking them back 3 tiles and leaving them [Damped] for 5 seconds, which lowers their damage.

fusions.name: Final Press
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health: you come down on it for 26 damage and leave it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Coiled Drop
fusions.desc: You hop 3 tiles, and your blunt damage rises by 30% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Level Ground
fusions.desc: When you kill something, your physical damage rises by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
